p.n: The Cat Puts His Trust in the Rat

body.p:
When the cat heard this from the rat, he knew that he was truthful
and said, ‘You are correct and have spoken the truth. See to the arrangement by which we can be rid
of this trouble, and I will act on it. I will remember this favor forever and will ensure
that I properly reward you.’

‘Allow me to approach to you,’ said the rat, ‘for if the owl and the weasel
see us in agreement, they will leave us, and when I am in safety from them, I will cut your bonds while feeling secure.’ “
